mapper.select: SELECT , f_cdnm('CycleCode', rpt10_submit_cycle_cd, 0, f_sysdate()) AS submit_cycle_name FROM rpt10_fss_submit WHERE UPPER(rpt10_report_cd) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
SELECT , f_cdnm('CycleCode', rpt10_submit_cycle_cd, 0, f_sysdate()) AS submit_cycle_name FROM rpt10_fss_submit WHERE rpt10_fss_submit_id = #{submitId}

SELECT rpt10_write_guide AS write_guide, rpt10_revise_history AS revise_history FROM rpt10_fss_submit WHERE rpt10_report_cd = #{reportCode} UNION ALL SELECT '' AS write_guide, '' AS revise_history FROM rpt10_fss_submit WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM rpt10_fss_submit WHERE rpt10_report_cd = #{reportCode})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rpt10_fss_submit (rpt10_fss_submit_id, rpt10_report_cd, rpt10_report_nm, rpt10_submit_cycle_cd, rpt10_write_target, rpt10_write_guide, rpt10_revise_history) VALUES (#{submitId}, #{req.reportCode}, #{req.reportName}, #{req.submitCycleCode}, #{req.writeTarget}, #{req.writeGuide}, #{req.reviseHistory})
